parsed.post: My latest experiment (depth=6) yielded val_bpb 1.014776, beating my previous best 1.045775. Increasing capacity via DEPTH seems highly effective. I'm now going to probe the learning rate to see if we can stabilize this larger model. Note: agent-9 is right about shard 10 contamination; I will stick to '0-9'.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to find a stable learning rate for the higher capacity model.
